title: A General Tool for Living Meta-Analysis
description:
A Shiny web application for interactive, reproducible living meta-analysis, supporting aggregated and multilevel effect-size models with frequentist (metafor) and Bayesian (bayesmeta, brms) estimation, meta-regression, correlated within-paper sampling errors, Bayes-factor robustness checks, and downloadable reproducible R scripts. Successor to the tool described in Allbritton, Gomez, Angele, Vasilev & Perea (2024), Journal of Cognition 7(1):61, doi:10.5334/joc.389.

The current development version of the app can be found at:

https://dallbrit.shinyapps.io/Meta_regression_app/
https://github.com/davidallbritton/living-meta-analysis-app
